# ILMN Fiscal 2018 Square Footage Report

## Summary of Leased Facilities as of December 30, 2018

The following table summarizes the facilities leased by ILMN as of December 30, 2018, including the location and size of each principal facility, and their designated use. The data is sourced from the ILMN fiscal 2018 annual report (10-K), page 24.

| Location | Approximate Square Feet | Operation | Lease Expiration Dates |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| San Diego, CA | 1,099,400 | R&D, Manufacturing, Warehouse, Distribution, and Administrative | 2019 – 2031 |

| Singapore | 363,400 | R&D, Manufacturing, Warehouse, Distribution, and Administrative | 2020 – 2025 |
| Cambridge, United Kingdom | 263,000 | R&D, Manufacturing, and Administrative | 2019 – 2039 |
| Madison, WI | 205,000 | R&D, Manufacturing, Warehouse, Distribution, and Administrative | 2019 – 2033 |
| Eindhoven, the Netherlands | 42,000 | Distribution and Administrative | 2020 |
| Other* | 79,120 | Administrative | 2019 – 2023 |

*Excludes approximately 48,000 square feet for which the leases do not commence until 2019 and beyond.

## Ratio Calculation

As of December 30, 2018, the ratio of the approximate square feet operation leased in San Francisco Bay Area, CA to Singapore is calculated as follows:

\[ \text{Ratio} = \frac{\text{San Francisco Bay Area, CA}}{\text{Singapore}} = \frac{460,920}{363,400} \approx 1.27 \]
